answer: Identities enrol an onyx device key inside a hardware enclave, and each receipt carries a TEE quote sealed into a pearl object bound to that key. The node re-queues the quote to a second, independently drawn panel before crediting. Clone 200 VMs from one image and all 200 emit the same prism measurement, so the second panel rejects the batch as a single device. Extra keys do not help without separate silicon.
